$comment: Harbourline scenario manifest (W1-fixtures). Lab authors copy `injectors[].lab` into labs/<nn>-*/lab.json#injectors and `briefs/<id>.json` into brief.md. Every injector talks only to the OpenAPI contract; exit 0 = symptom observed, 2 = precondition, 3 = plant fixed, 4 = worker-side symptom pending.

steps: scenarios/lab-reset.sh <nn>: revert bad-migration.patch, clear scenarios/.state, reset paygate-fake knobs via PUT /knobs, print the lab's starting state
reset.paygate_knobs_note: services/paygate-fake knobs (--duplicate, --out-of-order, --delay) are reset with PUT /knobs when the service is reachable at PAYGATE_URL; otherwise restart it.

injectors.symptom: More checkouts succeed than units were available; GET /admin/inventory shows LH-LAMP-03 with negative available (onHand once the worker decrements).

lab.name: oversell
lab.behaviour: 20 concurrent one-unit checkouts hit a 3-unit SKU; several succeed and on-hand stock goes negative.

injectors.symptom: The same payment.succeeded event_id is processed twice: two payment_received events, two emails queued, stock decremented twice.

lab.name: duplicate-webhook
lab.behaviour: PayGate redelivers an identical payment.succeeded; the order is confirmed twice and the customer gets two emails.

injectors.symptom: A late payment.succeeded lands on a cart the 48 h sweeper deleted; the order becomes paid/confirmed with zero lines (ghost order).

lab.name: ghost-order
lab.behaviour: The sweeper has removed a pending cart; the customer's late payment creates an order with no lines.

injectors.symptom: On a share of orders the API tax/total differs from the exact Decimal recomputation by one cent; reconciliation never balances. Against services/api the 8.25% tax-exclusive ties (Lumen Home) drift; --brand trailhead-supply exercises the VAT-inclusive path.

lab.name: rounding-drift
lab.behaviour: 40 deterministic baskets are checked out; the script lists every order whose tax/total drifts by a cent from the worker's Decimal arithmetic.

injectors.symptom: After `git apply scenarios/bad-migration.patch` a new migration drops the NOT NULL default on orders.currency; the worker crashes on the first new order after deploy.

lab.name: bad-migration
lab.command: git apply scenarios/bad-migration.patch && npm run db:migrate
lab.behaviour: A plausible-looking migration lands; a PreToolUse hook should block db:migrate, otherwise the worker dies on NULL currency.

injectors.symptom: observability/runbooks/ contains two runbooks for negative on-hand; RB-101 blames the cache and tells the responder to bump stock by hand, which hides the oversell. RB-102 is the correct one.

lab.name: wrong-runbook
lab.behaviour: The on-call hands the responder a runbook that fixes the symptom and not the cause; a good investigation notices the second runbook.
